description: Defines the NetworkIsolationKey class used for isolating shared network resources based on request context, including constructors, comparison operators, serialization methods, and related nested classes.

classes.name: NetworkIsolationKey
classes.description: Class used to manage network resource isolation keys, supporting different modes (triple-key and 2.5-key), with methods for comparison, serialization, and construction.

classes.name: NetworkIsolationKey::SerializationPasskey
classes.description: Passkey class for serialization-related access control.

classes.name: NetworkIsolationKey::CookiePartitionKeyPasskey
classes.description: Passkey class for cookie partition key construction.

methods.name: NetworkIsolationKey()
methods.description: Default constructor, creates an empty key.

methods.name: NetworkIsolationKey(const NetworkIsolationKey&)
methods.description: Copy constructor.

methods.name: NetworkIsolationKey(NetworkIsolationKey&&)
methods.description: Move constructor.

methods.name: ~NetworkIsolationKey()
methods.description: Destructor.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operators (copy and move).

methods.name: CreateTransient()
methods.description: Creates a transient, opaque network isolation key.

methods.name: CreateWithNewFrameSite()
methods.description: Creates a new key with a different frame site.

methods.name: ToDoUseTopFrameOriginAsWell()
methods.description: Temporary method to create a key using origin for both top frame and frame.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality comparison based on current mode.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Inequality comparison.

methods.name: operator<
methods.description: Ordering comparison.

methods.name: ToCacheKeyString()
methods.description: Returns string representation for cache key, or nullopt if transient.

methods.name: ToDebugString()
methods.description: Returns debug string of the key.

methods.name: IsFullyPopulated()
methods.description: Checks if all parts of the key are set.

methods.name: IsTransient()
methods.description: Checks if the key is transient.

methods.name: GetTopFrameSite()
methods.description: Returns optional top frame site.

methods.name: GetFrameSite()
methods.description: Returns optional frame site.

methods.name: GetIsCrossSite()
methods.description: Returns optional boolean indicating cross-site status.

methods.name: GetNonce()
methods.description: Returns optional nonce.

methods.name: GetMode()
methods.description: Returns current mode (kFrameSiteEnabled or kCrossSiteFlagEnabled).

methods.name: GetFrameSiteForSerialization()
methods.description: Returns frame site for serialization, requires passkey.

methods.name: GetFrameSiteForCookiePartitionKey()
methods.description: Returns frame site for cookie partition key, requires passkey.

methods.name: GetIsCrossSiteForSerialization()
methods.description: Returns cross-site boolean for serialization, requires passkey.
